summary: subscription.state is declared a full-value family: the newest claim of each subscription and writer is its whole value, tested against every reader; nothing is removed

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change. A new fractal-schema module lists full-value families; it has no runtime effect.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule added; the rules digest is unchanged. Only the unhashed pending reason of subscription.state in retention.toml now names the contract.

compatibility.detail: No wire, stored format, claim kind or client contract change. Readers behave as before; a later, separately approved step may retire superseded subscription.state claims.
